extended.basis: Real lives flown with the v2 controllers: 9/12 successes (frozen final controller make_robust: 6/8, incl. 4/5 on the dedicated calibration lives x3 1-5; make_final 3/4). Beta(1,1) posterior mean on 9/12 = 0.71. The code-world ensemble (every parameter perturbed +-15%, random initial spin) gives 10/10, so it is NOT used directly: the official run showed the world over-predicting by 68 points. I shade 0.71 down to 0.65 because several real successes were marginal (tip 0.08-0.09 m of the 0.10 m radius) and the 12 calibration seeds are few; the range is roughly the 80% posterior interval.
